result.title: Specificity-Aware Diffusion Steering via Variance-Reduced Sequential Monte Carlo
result.summary: Inference-time steering enables pretrained diffusion models to satisfy new constraints without full retraining. However, specificity-aware generation is difficult: repelling samples from a negative reference distribution can also erode the positive distribution where the two overlap. The key challenge is to suppress negative mass while minimally distorting the positive distribution. We address this problem by formulating specificity-aware steering as a target-design problem and deriving a target distribution from an overlap-based objective. The resulting target keeps the desired reference distribution only in regions where it is sufficiently preferred over the undesired reference distribution, giving a likelihood-ratio interpretation of specificity. To sample from the corresponding time-dependent target path, we develop a Sequential Monte Carlo sampler with a variance-minimized local proposal. We further introduce a practical fixed-noise optimization procedure with the Jacobian--vector products with the desired and undesired score fields. Experiments on synthetic task, class-contrastive generation, text-to-image tasks and peptide-MHC (p-MHC) binder show that the proposed method suppresses undesired regions more effectively, reduces mode shift, and improves sampling stability by decreasing the SMC weight collapse compared with negative-guidance baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/WangLuran/Specificity-Aware-Diffusion-Steering

AI.brief_summary: 该文把「特异性」生成形式化为目标分布设计问题，用基于重叠的似然比目标在正、负参考分布重叠区抑制负质量，并用方差最小化的局部提议做序贯蒙特卡洛采样，在合成任务、类别对比生成、文生图和 p-MHC 结合物上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 与主线非直接相关，但其「似然比刻画特异性 + SMC 提议/重采样 + 权重坍缩」的框架可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、多假设 latent 加权与停止决策提供概念线索，可供核查其是否可以迁移到推理状态粒子的筛选与保留。
